text:
Clara Wu: Heads-up  we're still getting inconsistent client behavior when routing falls back or quota hits. Console badges, SDK reactions, and support alerts don't agree. Can we define a minimal surface that also gives actionable hints to clients (not just status enums)?

Diego Alvarez: Agree. Instead of just client_status, can we add a compact "client_action" hint that tells SDKs suggested action: (NONE, RETRY, BACKOFF, FALLTHROUGH, CONTACT_SUPPORT). That keeps UX consistent across platforms. Console can translate those into badges/CTA.

Anya Sokolov: I like client_action. Suggest pairing it with a low-cardinality "error_channel" (ROUTING | QUOTA | CACHE | MODEL | DEPENDENCY) and a numeric "signal_level" (0-3) so console can compute severity without parsing text.

Clara Wu: Good. Also add "surface_variant" (compact | verbose) so mobile apps can pick short copy. And a safe "visible_message_key" for i18n; visible_message string only if surface_variant=verbose and visibility=public.

Diego Alvarez: Telemetry names: tag.err_channel, tag.client_action, tag.signal_level, tag.surface_variant, tag.quota_tier (low|med|high). We'll aggregate err_channel and quota_tier; don't index route_origin raw.

Anya Sokolov: SDK mapping rules: map client_action->behavior. RETRY -> exponential backoff with max_retries from config; BACKOFF -> show gentle throttle UI and schedule retry; FALLTHROUGH -> proceed with downgraded UX (e.g., simpler model); CONTACT_SUPPORT -> surface contact flow. If client_action missing, fallback to legacy HTTP mapping (429->THROTTLED, 5xx->FAILED).

Clara Wu: Example payload we can use in RFC and SDK tests:```json
{ "error": { "client_status": "RETRYABLE", "client_action": "BACKOFF", "error_channel": "QUOTA", "signal_level": "2", "quota_tier": "high", "retry_after_ms": 30000, "surface_variant": "compact", "visibility": "public", "visible_message_key": "quota.limit.near" } }
```

Diego Alvarez: For console badges: mapping proposal -> signal_level 0 = green, 1 = yellow, 2 = amber w/ CTA, 3 = red. Also show client_action as secondary CTA (e.g., BACKOFF shows "Try in 30s", FALLTHROUGH shows "Using reduced quality"). Add runbook links per err_channel.

Anya Sokolov: Rollout plan: behind per-tenant flag. Stage 1: 5% sampled traffic for 48h with debug.raw_error sampling and new telemetry. Stage 2: 25% for 72h with canary_verdict metrics (percent_mapped, sdk_fallback_rate, badge_delta). Gate: abort if sdk_fallback_rate increases >5% absolute or if percent_mapped < 98% after 72h.

ops-bot: Feature flag client-action-hint-v1 created. Canary enabled for eng-platform at 2025-06-01T16:00Z.

Diego Alvarez: Console impl note: aggregate quota_tier and err_channel into small pivot tables to avoid high-cardinality. Use signal_level for badge color logic. We'll need a small translation table for client_action -> UI copy per locale.

Clara Wu: I'll draft RFC with schema, telemetry names, SDK mapping table, console badge rules, and rollout gates. Draft ETA: EOD Monday. Anya, can you own the SDK PR and unit tests?

Anya Sokolov: On it. I'll add parsing tests, locale fallback tests, and ensure legacy fallback behavior. Ping me when RFC is up.

Clara Wu: RFC path: rfc/1799998888-client-action-and-signal-level.md  linking when posted. Thanks all :sparkles:
